title: Fed keeps interest rates unchanged at 3.75-4%, two officials dissented in favor of a rate hike
summary: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate at 3.75-4% on October 28. Governors Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack (Cleveland Fed) dissented in favor of a 25bp hike — the first dissents in this cycle. Markets now price roughly 71% probability of a December hike.
why: 延续报道：10月28日决策后市场对12月加息的定价持续发酵，黄金月内跌超6%，高利率预期将压制成长股估值；sell put组合的行权价风险窗口上移，需持续跟踪12月FOMC措辞。

title: China NBS Manufacturing PMI falls to 49.3 in October, both manufacturing and services contract
summary: China's official NBS Manufacturing PMI fell to 49.3 in October from 50.1 in September, missing the consensus forecast of 50.0 and returning to contraction. Production sub-index dropped to 49.8 and new-orders gauge slipped to 49.4. Non-Manufacturing PMI also slipped below 50 to 49.7 (vs. 50.2 prior). NBS cited demand pull-forward ahead of the National Day holiday and a complex international environment. High-tech manufacturing PMI held at 51.3.
why: 中国10月制造业PMI跌破荣枯线至49.3，服务业PMI同步跌至49.7，双双收缩。9月短暂回升后再度走弱，超出市场预期（共识50.0），是今年以来最差的宏观信号之一。对港/A股顺周期板块（工业、材料、消费品）及腾讯/美团等消费相关标的构成压制；叠加美联储维持高利率，双重宏观逆风。需跟踪政策面能否在11月出台更多刺激措施。

title: Apple overtakes Nvidia to reclaim world's most valuable company title at $5.03T market cap
summary: Apple (AAPL) overtook Nvidia (NVDA) on October 30 to become the world's most valuable public company at $5.03T, as Nvidia fell 4.2% to $4.93T. This is the first such flip since July. Investors rotated toward Apple amid concerns about AI infrastructure spending returns — Apple's steadier capex profile seen as a relative safe haven amid the tech selloff.
why: 苹果市值超越英伟达折射市场对AI算力支出回报时间线的疑虑；两者差距仅约1000亿美元（不足Nvidia日常波动），排名可随时反转。若AI回报担忧持续，可能进一步影响科技赛道整体估值；对长期持有Nvidia的投资者是警示信号。
